title: You're Using the WRONG Gear After RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1!
author: GamerCory
description:
You're Using the WRONG Gear After RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1!

RuneScape Dragonwilds update 1.0.1 changed which equipment is worth using, and some of your favorite gear might not be as powerful as it was before!

In this video, we're covering the Amulet of Glory nerf, the Unholy Symbol, Salve Amulet, new ring and amulet equipment slots, and the ranged combat changes introduced in update 1.0.1.

We'll also look at the new Rapid Fire, Power Shot, and Heavy Bolt special attacks, changes to ranged ammunition, and why the best equipment depends on your combat style and the enemies you're fighting.

Before spending more resources upgrading your equipment, make sure you understand what changed!

More RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides, updates, tips, and discoveries as I progress through the game!
